2608.05588.title: Search-Aided Joint Agent-Environment Reinforcement Learning for Robust Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding with Rotations
2608.05588.paper_summary: Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding (LMAPF) requires repeatedly planning collision-free paths for agents that continuously receive new goals upon reaching their current ones. While many learning-based planners have been proposed for LMAPF, most rely on oversimplified kinematic assumptions that may overlook motion constraints critical to real-world performance. In this work, we study a more realistic LMAPF model derived from many real-world automated warehouse systems, termed LMAPF-R2, which incorporates robust safety constraints and in-place rotation constraints. These constraints substantially increase coordination difficulty, particularly in highly constrained spaces. To address these challenges, we propose Search-Aided Joint Reinforcement Learning (SJRL). We first augment neural policies with Causal PIBT, a single-step search-based planner that resolves agents' collisions and propagates their intentions. We then introduce a unified RL formulation that jointly optimizes agent and environment policies, where the environment policy learns graph edge costs to provide global movement guidance via backward Dijkstra search. Experiments demonstrate that SJRL achieves significant improvements over the strong search-based planner, Causal-PIBT, across multiple high-density maps. We further validate SJRL in a challenging mixed-reality warehouse environment with 8 physical robots and 248 virtual robots.
2608.05588.paper_summary_zh: 終身多代理路徑尋找（LMAPF）需要為代理重複規劃無碰撞路徑，這些代理在達到當前目標後會持續接收新的目標。雖然已經提出了許多基於學習的規劃器來解決LMAPF，但大多數依賴於過於簡化的運動學假設，可能忽視對於現實世界表現至關重要的運動約束。在這項工作中，我們研究了一個更現實的LMAPF模型，源自許多現實世界的自動化倉庫系統，稱為LMAPF-R2，該模型納入了穩健的安全約束和原地旋轉約束。這些約束顯著增加了協調的難度，特別是在高度受限的空間中。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了搜尋輔助聯合強化學習（SJRL）。我們首先用因果PIBT增強神經策略，這是一種基於單步搜尋的規劃器，能解決代理之間的碰撞並傳播它們的意圖。然後，我們引入了一個統一的強化學習公式，該公式共同優化代理和環境策略，其中環境策略學習圖邊成本，以通過反向Dijkstra搜尋提供全局運動指導。實驗表明，SJRL在多個高密度地圖上相較於強大的基於搜尋的規劃器因果PIBT取得了顯著的改進。我們進一步在一個具有挑戰性的混合現實倉庫環境中驗證了SJRL，該環境中有8個實體機器人和248個虛擬機器人。
